effect: The control panel completed the garden-ready fair, and the rehearsal confirmed that the whale could rise, operate its attractions and return to the cradle.
reaction: The rehearsal was a satisfying payoff for the landing and safety preparations.

mostWorthwhile.text: Positioning the padded cradle was most worthwhile: it gave the flying whale a clear, gentle place to return.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the aiming wedge felt rather routine; its result confirmed the aim but offered little else to think about.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the rehearsal brought the earlier preparations together as expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the later choices were essentially a fixed sequence rather than meaningful decisions.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see the fair receive its guests, though I would hope for more choices or new mechanisms than this mostly straightforward setup offered.
